# Register-ZbxPassiveProxyDataProvider

## SYNOPSIS

Registers a scriptblock that supplies values each time the server pulls a passive proxy session's data.

## SYNTAX

```
Register-ZbxPassiveProxyDataProvider [-Name] <string> [-ScriptBlock] <ScriptBlock> [-PassThru] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Register-ZbxPassiveProxyDataProvider cmdlet adds a data provider to the passive proxy session named in -Name: before each proxy data pull, the session runs the scriptblock on its own runspace with the configuration it holds, and a ZabbixProxyDataPage the scriptblock returns joins the values the server takes. Returning nothing adds nothing. Several providers may be registered, and their pages are merged. It writes the session only with -PassThru.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Supply a value with every pull

```powershell
Register-ZbxPassiveProxyDataProvider -Name 'dmz-proxy' -ScriptBlock {
    param($config)
    $item = $config.Items.Values | Where-Object Key -eq 'app.requests'
    if (-not $item) { return }
    $now = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow
    $value = [Community.Zabbix.Proxy.ZabbixProxyHistoryItem]::new($now.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(), $item.ItemId, $now, '42')
    [Community.Zabbix.Proxy.ZabbixProxyDataPage]::new([Community.Zabbix.Proxy.ZabbixProxyHistoryItem[]]@($value), $null, $null, $null, $null)
}
```

The provider finds the item in the configuration and returns one value for it.
